rules.raw_move: moves = ratio >= 1.10 and p < 0.01; unclear = one of the two; doesn't = neither; other = days with no CPI, NFP, Fed, RET, PCE, GDP, ECB, HICP or ISM reaction
rules.surprise: tracks = corr as expected, p < 0.01, hit rate >= 60%; unclear = one of the two; doesn't = neither
rules.walk_forward: holds = right on at least 60% of at least 30 predictions, binomial p < 0.01 against 50%; too few = under 30 predictions
